name: Cloud 9 | 1.2g Infused Preroll | Motown Pound Cake
description:
Motown Pound Cake

Smooth and full of Detroit soul. Motown Pound Cake is for laid-back legends, the kind of high that wraps around you like a slow jam and doesn’t let go.

Flavor Profile: Sweet Cream · Lemon Cake · Gas

Effects: Sedative Euphoria · Deep Relaxation

Primary Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, ß-Caryophyllene
